```{r setup}
library(hlebuhanec.0325)
library(RGCCA)
library(GimmeMyPlot)
library(tidyverse)
library(rlist)
library(GimmeMyOmics)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 2000 * 1024^2)
options(ggrepel.max.overlaps = 1000)
```

## Data preparation
```{r}
data("microbiome_adj_pn")
data("counts_adj_pn")

l_name_omics <- list(RNA = colnames(counts_adj_pn), Microbiome = colnames(microbiome_adj_pn))
plot_venn(l_name_omics)

common_ids <- intersect(l_name_omics[[1]], l_name_omics[[2]])
blocks <- list(Microbiome = microbiome_adj_pn, RNA = counts_adj_pn) %>%
  list.map(t(.[, common_ids]) %>% as.matrix())

lapply(blocks, dim)
```

## Analysis
```{r}
# a_rgcca <- rgcca(blocks, ncomp = rep(2, 2))
a_rgcca <- rgcca(blocks, sparsity = c(1, .1), ncomp = rep(2, 2), method = "sgcca")
```


```{r}
df <- Reduce(cbind, a_rgcca$Y) %>% as.data.frame() %>% set_colnames(paste0(rep(names(a_rgcca$blocks), each = 2), colnames(.)))

data("clinic2")
scores <- filter(clinic2, patient %in% rownames(df)) %>% left_join(rownames_to_column(df, "patient"), ., by = "patient") %>% pull(eva_prurit)
```

```{r}
library(GimmeMyCluster)
df_scaled <- scale(df)
dist <- getDistance(df_scaled)
a_cl <- run_clustering(dist)
```

```{r}
cls <- extract_clusters(a_cl)$clusters
list.map(cls, as.character(.) %>% fct_count(prop = TRUE))
```

```{r}
library(kableExtra)

tab <- map2_dfr(
    list.map(cls, as.character(.) %>% fct_count(prop = TRUE)),
    seq_along(cls),
    ~ mutate(.x, k = paste("k = ", .y + 1))
) %>%
    select(k, everything())

grey_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "black"))(100)

tab %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    col.names = c("k", "Cluster", "n", "Proportion"),
    digits = 3,
    align = "c"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(
    4,
    background = grey_palette[round(tab$p * 99) + 1],
    color = ifelse(tab$p > 0.5, "white", "black")
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "middle")
```

## QC
```{r}
sil <- getSilhouettePerPart(dist, cls) %>%
  getMeanSilhouettePerPart()
plotSilhouettePerPart(sil)
optimal_k <- which.max(sil) + 1
optimal_k
cl <- cls[[optimal_k - 1]]
table(cl)
```

```{r}
sil_k <- getSilhouette(dist, cl)
plotSilhouette(sil_k)
sil_k[, optimal_k]  %>% .[which.min(.)]
```


```{r}
heatMap(df_scaled, dist = dist, c = a_cl, cl = cl)
```

```{r}
plotDendrogram(a_cl, cl, optimal_k)
```

```{r}
blocks[[1]] %>%
    getDiscriminantVariables(cl, optimal_k, 15) %>%
    select(1) %>%
    plot_bar_rgcca(width_text = 50)

blocks[[2]] %>%
    getDiscriminantVariables(cl, optimal_k, 15) %>%
    rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") %>%
    left_join(metadata_rna) %>%
    filter(gene_name != "") %>%
    mutate(gene_name = set_name_rna(gene_name)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
    select(2) %>%
    plot_bar_rgcca()
```

```{r}
plot_disc_per_cl <- function(x, cl, optimal_k, ...) {
  p <- x %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    getCtrVar(cl, optimal_k) %>% 
    multiply_by(100)
  
   list.map(
    rownames(p),
    f(x) ~t(p) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    arrange(desc(!!sym(x))) %>%
    select(!!sym(x)) %>% 
    plot_bar_rgcca(title = x, ...)
  )
}

plot_disc_per_cl(blocks[[1]], cl, optimal_k, width_text = 50)
plot_disc_per_cl(blocks[[2]], cl, optimal_k)
```
